card.name: Start of a word's second piece
card.fires_on: A short piece in the middle of a word, right before the rest of a split word begins, such as 'os' in immun-os-uppression or an odd break before 'peechreading' or 'leep'. Also on 'S' or 'SS' starting abbreviations like SJS or cSSSI.

modes.label: Inside immunosuppression
modes.description: The 'os' piece in immun-os-uppression after corticosteroid-induced or in transplant settings.
modes.example: corticosteroid-induced immun<<os>>uppression may lead to Strongylo

modes.label: Broken-off word start
modes.description: A stray or odd break where a word starts mid-way, such as an 's' lost from speechreading or sleep.
modes.example: extreme drowsiness<</s>>leep induced by antihistamine use

modes.label: Abbreviation starts
modes.description: The first letters of capitalised abbreviations like SJS or cSSSI.

card.plain: It fires partway through words that are split oddly, especially immunosuppression and abbreviations like SJS.
